::: {.callout-warning}
## Safety

Whatever can hurt a student or the hardware, stated before the first step:
mains-powered instruments, hot water, heat guns, voltages above the board's
$V_\mathrm{io}$.
:::

### 1. Identify the board {#sec-{{IDL}}-step-identify}

```bash
arduino-io list
arduino-io info
```

### 2. TODO (Paolo) {#sec-{{IDL}}-step-two}

One numbered step per thing the student does, each with the exact command.

### N. Fill the sidecars {#sec-{{IDL}}-step-sidecar}

- [ ] `board.adc_bits`, `board.vref_mV`, `board.usbio_version`
- [ ] `host.os`, `host.machine`, `host.hub`
- [ ] `acquisition.requested_period_us` **and** `acquisition.achieved_rate_hz`
- [ ] all six `stream_stats` counters
- [ ] per channel: `reference_value` and `reference_u`
- [ ] `references[]`: instrument models and calibration state
- [ ] `synthetic: false`
